title: Telecommunications Act
verified_how: Fetched the index page: title 'Telecommunications Act', citation (S.C. 1993, c. 38), current to 2026-07-21, last amended 2026-06-15.
notes: Covers telecom services only. Consumer billing rules such as the Wireless Code and Internet Code are CRTC decisions made under this Act. Electricity, gas and water billing are provincial or municipal.
